scope: One infrastructure-to-vehicle encoded feature packet per frame; includes codec headers and metadata, excludes network framing and retransmission

manifest.protocol: paired vehicle/infrastructure, cooperative world GT projected to vehicle; no injected delay

evaluation.metric: BEV and upright 3D AP; paired vehicle/infrastructure, cooperative world GT projected to vehicle; no injected delay
evaluation.ap_convention: VOC2010 precision-envelope integral; global score sorting; not KITTI R11/R40
evaluation.iou_3d: rotated BEV intersection area times height overlap / volume union
